description: This file contains C++ source code implementing cuDNN-based convolution operations for PyTorch, including plan generation, execution, and caching of convolution plans using the cuDNN frontend API, with support for fused operations and heuristics.

classes.name: CacheKey
classes.description: Unique key for caching convolution engine configurations, based on convolution parameters and memory alignments.

classes.name: CacheKeyFused
classes.description: Unique key for caching fused convolution engine configurations, including additional tensors and alpha value.

classes.name: CacheKeyWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper around CacheKey to facilitate hashing and equality comparison.

classes.name: CacheKeyFusedWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper around CacheKeyFused for hashing and comparison.

classes.name: BenchmarkCache
classes.description: Thread-local cache storing execution plans, supporting lookup, insertion, and cache eviction policies.
